usca-unit-agreement-2022-2027.notes: Each link names the USCA and each earlier term ends before the next starts, but two extensions (about 12 weeks in 2018 and a full year in 2022) are not documented anywhere published. Treat links 2 and 3 as the published record, not a guaranteed complete one. Despite 're-opener' in its title, the 2007-2011 document is a full executed agreement with recognition, grievance and other articles.

ufa-moa-2017-2020.notes: Covers the Firefighter/Fire Marshal unit, the MOA's main unit: the contract ends July 31, 2017, the day before the MOA starts. The MOA also modifies separate Wiper and Pilot/Marine Engineer agreements ('expired on July 31, 2017 and July 27, 2018'). Those were not chained: no Wiper or Pilot agreement for 2010-2018 is published apart from the UFA 2010-2017 MOA (read: covers 'Wiper (F), Pilot, and Marine Engineer', term 8/1/2010-7/31/2017 and 8/8/2011-7/27/2018). The older CBU 41 Wipers (2008-2010) and CBU 068 Pilots (2007-2011) contracts on OLR were not read. The CBU 41 2008-2010 contract in contracts.json 'predecessor' is superseded.

ufoa-fire-officers-2018-2021.notes: The current document is itself a complete executed contract (Fire Officers 2018-2021 Agreement, March 20, 2018 to July 30, 2021, with Article XVIII Grievance Procedure). For reference, the nearest predecessor is the UFOA Fire Officers executed contract, March 20, 2011 to March 19, 2018 (https://www.nyc.gov/assets/olr/downloads/pdf/collectivebargaining/ufoa-fire-officers-executed-contract-2011-2018.pdf; p.1 'TERM: MARCH 20, 2011 TO MARCH 19, 2018'), which ends the day before. No UFOA successor agreement is published. The 2007-2011 CBU 43 contract in contracts.json 'predecessor' is superseded.
